image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a male mallard duck (drake) floating on water. The duck is resting with its head tucked back onto its body. Visible features include an iridescent green head, a yellow bill, a white neck ring, mottled brown and grey body plumage, and the characteristic curled black tail feathers.
